title: GT 710 firmware display
summary: The firmware framebuffer belongs to the GT 710, whose PCI resources and firmware display claim are reported.

cases.title: BAR1 and BAR2 preserve nonce-bearing boundary patterns with explicit cache types and bounded coherent DMA; engine access remains pending
Private GPU tables preserve distinct same-VA backing, ordered remaps and reserved storage; engine translation remains pending
VRAM charges and reusable guarded allocations preserve reserved storage across independent nonce-bearing PRAMIN/BAR views; engine translation remains pending
Both EDID modes latch private A-B-A surfaces with complete pixels, suppressed-update recovery and native console handoff
A second advertised EDID mode switches low-high-low with latched timings, link state and complete unique-pixel read-back
The preferred EDID mode completes on owned native scanout with advancing raster and full pixel read-back
Private display allocations preserve inherited VRAM and pass complete complementary physical read-back without aliasing
Live board tables, POST and active TMDS routing identify the attached DDC sink and its preferred timing
The firmware framebuffer report gives its mode, pixel format, pitch, base and mapped size
The whole firmware framebuffer lies in the reported GT 710 memory BAR, not the embedded display
The same GT 710 capture passes firmware ownership, display claim, screen read-back and the complete E16 console suite
The PCI report identifies 10de:128b with subsystem 1462:8c93 and its interrupt line
The PCI report lists the display BARs and the negotiated PCIe link from its capability registers
Display discovery and the firmware framebuffer claim name the same GT 710 function
